findings.current: I forced the corners of my mouth up and spoke in a solemn voice.
findings.defect: The draft makes him force a smile rather than struggle to suppress one.
findings.rationale: After enjoying Hwaran’s embrace, he tries to maintain a serious expression.
findings.replacement: I fought to keep the corners of my mouth from rising and spoke in a solemn voice.
findings.source: 억지로 입꼬리에 힘을 주며 진중한 목소리로 입을 열었다.

findings.current: But unlike my Master, his Disciple had stayed in Sichuan, and there was no question he was a master physician worthy of the title.
findings.defect: “My Master” identifies Jeok Cheongang as the physician’s teacher.
findings.rationale: The master here is the original Divine Physician, identified in the preceding sentence as the Slaughter Saint.
findings.replacement: But unlike his master, the Disciple had stayed in Sichuan, and he was a physician every bit as worthy of the title.
findings.source: 스승과 달리 사천에 남은 제자도 신의라 부르기에 조금의 부족함도 없는 명의다.

findings.current: It felt like I’d lost my life after borrowing from loan sharks to win at a gambling table.
findings.defect: The gambler has ruined his life, not lost it.
findings.rationale: 인생 말아먹은 describes a wrecked life; the debt analogy does not say the gambler died.
findings.replacement: I felt like a gambler who’d borrowed from loan sharks to keep playing, only to ruin his life.
findings.source: 마치 도박판에서 이기기 위해 사채까지 끌어쓰다 인생 말아먹은 도박꾼이 된 기분이다.

findings.current: You think you can act like this in front of your senior?
findings.defect: Namho specifically invokes Senior Jeok, not his own seniority.
findings.rationale: 적 선배 names the senior whose presence Namho appeals to in the argument.
findings.replacement: You think you can act like this in front of Senior Jeok?
findings.source: 마, 너 적 선배 앞에서 이렇게 굴 수 있어?

findings.current: finally started showing signs of infirmities of old age.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the specific dementia joke with a broad reference to aging.
findings.rationale: 치매 specifically means dementia; the later exchange plays on doubts about Namho’s memory and judgment.
findings.replacement: finally started showing signs of dementia.

findings.defect: Taekyung’s audible switch from his familiar address to the more respectful one is omitted.
findings.rationale: 노야, 아니 스승님 explicitly corrects the form of address mid-sentence.
findings.replacement: “Old Master—no, my Master went to Sichuan?”

findings.current: “The best medicine in the world for the sick Pavilion Master—the medicine Taishan likes best!”
findings.defect: The draft reverses Taishan’s self-correction, making his appetite the afterthought rather than the thought he tries to conceal.
findings.rationale: He first blurts out that it is his favorite thing, then corrects himself to claim he brought medicine.
findings.replacement: “Taishan’s favorite thing in the world—no, a miracle cure for the sick Pavilion Master!”
findings.source: “태산이가 세상에서 제일 좋아하는, 아니 아픈 각주를 치료할 명약!”

findings.current: “Oh, thank heaven. Earth Mother Goddess, I could kiss your feet.
findings.defect: The draft substitutes the Earth Mother Goddess for the invoked gods of heaven and earth and adds an offer to kiss their feet.
findings.rationale: 천지신명 is the invocation here; neither the Earth Mother Goddess nor the added gesture appears in the source.
findings.replacement: “Oh, thank you, gods of heaven and earth.

findings.defect: The second invocation again changes the gods of heaven and earth into the Earth Mother Goddess.
findings.rationale: The source names 원시천존 and 천지신명 as distinct invocations.
findings.replacement: “……Primordial Heavenly Venerable. Gods of heaven and earth.”

findings.current: That damage, which even leveling up hadn’t healed, was needling me around the dantian.
findings.defect: The injury’s location is narrowed to the lower dantian in the source.
findings.rationale: 하단전 specifies the lower dantian, not an unspecified dantian.
findings.replacement: That damage, which even leveling up hadn’t healed, was needling me around the lower dantian.
findings.source: 그 흔적이, 하단전 어림을 쿡쿡 쑤시고 있었다.

findings.current: “Going too far, my ass. The one who went too far was your underling Taishan—or was it Tiger Giant?—and his appetite.
findings.defect: “Tiger Giant” replaces Namho’s deliberate mangling of Taishan’s name with an unrelated epithet.
findings.rationale: 금수강산 is a joking substitution built around the mountain in Taishan’s name, not Taishan’s giant-related nickname.
findings.replacement: “Going too far, my ass. What’s going too far is the appetite of that underling of yours—Taishan, Scenic Mountain, whatever his name is.
findings.source: “말이 심하긴 니미럴. 심한 건 태산인지 금수강산인지 하는 네 수하 놈 식성 아니냐?

summary: The draft has two reversed comic beats, a misidentified master, and several losses of source-specific meaning.
